name: pixelpets-ipad-terminal
description: Browser terminal for this machine, driven from an iPad
//: Deliberately a package of its own, not part of the app. node-pty is a native module and xterm is browser-side - neither belongs in the Electron bundle, and hoisting them into the root manifest would ship both to every installer. Everything here is optional: with nothing installed the server still runs in line mode and loads xterm from a CDN.
